description: Pre-failure statistical feature distribution comparison (one-hour window prior to failure onset, Welch's t-test and Mann-Whitney U test)

features.interpretation: Substantial thermal accumulation in Event 4 (+13.64°C higher pre-failure heat).
Electrical load more than doubled (+2.81 A), showing severe compressor motor strain.
Major compressor head pressure elevation (+4.54 bar) preceding failure.
Significant pressure drop (−4.04 bar) indicating severe pneumatic venting leakage.
Compressor duty cycle duty shifted drastically between the two operating regimes.
Discharge line pressure depleted (−0.36 bar), reflecting loss of sealed line integrity.

caveat: These differences indicate substantial operating and sensor distribution shifts between failure events, explaining why models trained exclusively on early regimes struggle to generalize. These are statistical associations, not proof of root physical causality.
